events.title: Two employees are killed when crushed by tipping metal sheet…
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Sooner Coating, Llc. Catoosa, OK. At 6:45 a.m. on December 6, 2024, two employees were conducting abrasive blasting on a 13,000-pound metal sheet measuring 33 feet long, 10 feet wide, and0.89 inches thick. The metal sheet had been positioned vertically within a blastbooth using an overhead crane and secured onto two steel I-beam base plates. During blasting operations, the weight of the sheet shifted, causing it to become imbalanced and tip over. The sheet fell onto the employees, fatally injuring both.

events.title: Two employees sustain burns contacting live wire, one dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Coxcom, Llc. Tulsa, OK. At 12:21 p.m. on November 20, 2024, Employee #1 and Employee #2 were working as telecommunications repair installers for a telecommunications provider. The crew was investigating a mystery wire that was uncovered by a homeowner in the back yard of a residence. The crew was tryin to determine if the wire was a data cable or not. Employee #1 tested the wire and the meter indicated that there were 0 volts running through the wire. Employee #1 then retrieved a tool to cut a "window" into the outer…

events.title: Employee dies from head trauma in slip and fall on machine
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: The Crosby Group Llc. Tulsa, OK. At 1:00 p.m. on October 24, 2024, an employee working as a machine operator for a fabricated metal products manufacturer was removing tooling from a large sheave machine. The employee slipped and fell hitting his head on the machine. The employee died from head trauma.

events.title: Employee dies when stabbed in neck during robbery
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Eleven, Inc. Oklahoma City, OK. At 1:00 a.m. on October 18, 2024, an employee working as a cashier for a convenience store was assisting a customer with a purchase. When the employee turned around to get the customer a cigar, the customer entered the cashier area. Customer forced the employee to open the register and give them the money from the till. Although the employee complied with the request, the customer proceeded to stab the employee in the neck prior to departing store. The employee died from a knife wound to the…

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from scissor lift
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Warrior Steel, Llc. Mustang, OK. At 4:00 p.m. on August 12, 2024, Employee #1 was leaving the roof to return to the floor at the end of the workday when he fell from a scissor lift to the concrete. The employee sustained multiple injuries from the fall. Emergency responders were called to the scene, but the employee was pronounced dead from the injuries sustained upon impact with the concrete floor.

events.title: Employee dies from electrocution while performing tree trimm…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Wolfe Tree Services Llc. Tulsa, OK. At 11:00 a.m. on July 22, 2024, an employee working for a tree service had completed tree trimming duties and was preparing to climb down a tree. The employee contacted nearby energized power lines and was shocked. The employee died due to electrocution.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by high-pressure water blasti…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Allstream Services And Rental, Llc. Cushing, OK. At approximately 2:30 p.m. on June 29, 2024, an employee was performing maintenance and repair on an ultra-high pressure blasting wand. While observing the nozzle of the blasting wand to identify the defective tip, the employee stood close to the operator. The operator lost control of the wand, causing it to strike the employee in the neck. The employee sustained a fatal laceration to the neck from the high-pressure water, which was operating at 45,000 psi.

events.title: Employee is struck by UHP water stream, later dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Allstream Services And Rental, Llc. Cushing, OK. At 8:44 p.m. on June 29, 2024, a technician employed by a maintenance company was troubleshooting the nozzle hornet on an ultra-high pressure (UHP) hydroblaster at a facility. The technician was standing a few feet away from theblaster, attempting to determine which nozzle was not functioning properly. During the test, the UHP blaster lost control of the lance, and the lance swung over, causing the UHP water stream to strike the technician in the neck. The technician suffered a laceration to…

events.title: Employee falls while pulling wire through conduit and sustai…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bill'S Electric, Inc. Bixby, OK. At 4:02 p.m. on June 28, 2024, Employee #1, employed by an electrical contracting company, was pulling wire through a conduit while standing on an A frame ladder at a construction site. The wire became stuck, and as the employee continued to pull, the wire suddenly came free, causing him to fall backward onto a cement floor. The employee suffered a laceration to the back of the head and a concussion, resulting in employee's death.

events.title: Employee falls into compactor chute, sustains fatal injuries…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Pioneer Industries International. Oklahoma City, OK. At 3:00 p.m. on May 31, 2024, Employee #1 was working on an elevated platform approximately 20 feet in the air, assisting with pushing cardboard boxes into a chute leading to a box compactor. While in position, the employee fell into the chute and struck the working surface of the machinery below. The employee sustained fatal head trauma and multiple lacerations to the body from the impact. Emergency services responded, but the employee was pronounced dead at the scene.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by falling pipe
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Vallourec Star, Lp. Muskogee, OK. At 9:00 a.m. on May 13, 2024, Employee #1 was attempting to install a pipe chalk to secure a pipe into a storage rack position when a pipe from the top of the rack rolled off and struck the employee. The employee suffered fatal injuries, including fractures and asphyxiation, due to being struck by the steel pipe.

events.title: Employee dies from electrocution when ladder contacts power…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Blakley Construction Llc. Sulphur, OK. At 4:36 p.m. on April 23, 2024, an employee working as a construction laborer for a siding contractor was assisting a coworker installing metal gutters. The employee and the coworker (company owner) tied two portable ladders together to gain additional height to reach a roof edge 25 feet above the ground. They were raising the two ladders to the roof edge when the ladders tipped backwards and fell onto exposed and energized 7200-Kilivolt overhead power lines. The ladder that contacted the power…

events.title: Employee dies from UTI after becoming ill on farm in heat
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Blackwell Grower, Llc. Blackwell, OK. On April 9, 2024, an employee working as a farm worker for a produce farm began feeling ill while working in the heat. On April 10, 2024, the employer took the employee to a doctor who prescribed antibiotics. At 8:oo p.m. on April 12, 2024,the employer dropped the employee off outside of the hospital and left. Medical personnel saw him in distress outside and rendered care to him. The employee died from a urinary tract infection (UTI) due to a delay in treatment.

events.title: Employee dies from head trauma in fall off elevated platform…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Mtm Recognition Corporation. Del City, OK. At 2:00 p.m. on April 9, 2024, an employee working in sales for a metal productsmanufacturer was completing an order fulfillment in the warehouse. The employee was operating a Class II electric narrow aisle order picker powered industrial truck (PIV). The employee was gathering an order from a height of approximately 20 feet when he fell from the platform of the PIV. The employee was not wearing a fall protection harness. The employee died from a head injury due to impact with the concrete…

events.title: One employee is killed, another incurs gunshot wounds when s…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Cal'S Convenience, Inc. Lawton, OK. At 2:30 a.m. on March 24, 2024, an employee was taking a break with another employee who was off-duty and two customers. One of the customers chased both employees across the street and shot both employees. The off-duty employee suffered gunshot wounds and was hospitalized. The other employee was killed.

events.title: Employee suffers asphyxiation fatality after being trapped i…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Jerlow Construction Co. Shawnee, OK. At 2:00 p.m. on February 7, 2024, Employee #1 was working for a water/sewer linecontractor. Employee #1 was installing an 8" water line in a trench that was 8 ft 6 inches deep. The trench walls collapsed onto Employee #1 causing asphyxiation and his eventual death.

events.title: Employee is killed when caught between two trucks
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Steel City Metals Llc. Afton, OK. At 2:00 p.m. on January 30, 2024, an employee was spotting/assisting a flatbed truck being backed into position near a semi-truck trailer. The employee entered the area between the two trucks during the backing process and was crushed. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee dies after falling twice
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Accent Cleaning & Restoration Llc. Tulsa, OK. At 5:01 p.m. on January 22, 2024, an employee was preparing to finish replacing the water pump on one of the work vans. The employee appears to have fallen and gotten back up and then fell again, as evidenced by video. The employee died.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by vehicle
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Prestage Farms Of Oklahoma, Llc. Texhoma, OK. At 6:45 a.m. on November 30, 2023, an employee had begun his workday according to his normal schedule, which was to drive his personal vehicle to the wash station (West Yard), where he picked up his assigned truck and trailer (#526) before picking up his first load of weanling pigs at the assigned barn. On the day of the incident, he deviated from the route to stop at his personal residence. The employee was struck by a vehicle and found dead beneath the back tires (dual wheels) on the driver's…

events.title: Employee complains of head injury while unloading trailer of…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Fedex Ground Package Services Inc. Edmond, OK. At 12:00 p.m. on October 27, 2023, an employee complained about a head injury atwork, while unloading a trailer of packages. The employee was given aspirin, and then the employee asked to leave work early that day. The employee died. The employee's death is not covered by OSHA.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from ladder
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Wyatt Technical Services Inc. Tulsa, OK. At 11:23 a.m. on September 11, 2023, an employee was approximately 16 feet in the air on an extension ladder, installing a security camera on a corner of a building that had no power running to the camera. The employee fell from the ladder, impacting the ground below. The employee suffered severe head trauma and a fractured skull and neck. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by tree branch
events.description: 1 worker death. Stigler, OK. At 1:00 p.m. on July 17, 2023, an employee had gotten into an oak tree in order to cut a large oak branch that was dead so that it would not fall on the campingspot. The employee made the undercut on the limb which caused his chainsaw to become stuck. The employee was getting a second saw to make the top cut when thelimb fell and struck him. The employee died due to multiple blunt force injuries to his head, neck and torso. The employee suffered abrasions, contusions, and lacerations, lung and…

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by tree branch
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: D & P Contracting. Stigler, OK. At 1:00 p.m. on July 17, 2023, an employee was cutting a large branch from an oak tree. When the branch was cut from the tree, it bounced back and hit the employee in the chest. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee dies from possible heat stress valet parking cars
events.description: 1 worker death. Tulsa, OK. At 7:30 p.m. on July 13, 2023, an employee was valet parking cars at a country club. After parking two to three cars in approximately 30 minutes time, the employee returned to the reception area in obvious distress. The employee died from possible heat-related illness.

events.title: Employee is killed when shot by gunman
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Vibe Restaurants. Edmond, OK. At 10:30 p.m. on June 28, 2023, an employee was working at a food service counter. A gunman opened the customer service door and fired several shots from the doorway. The employee was killed by gunshot.

events.title: Two Employees are burned in gas release and fire, one later…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Cvr Common Services, Llc. Wynnewood, OK. At 9:00 a.m. on May 23, 2023, Employee #1 and Employee #2, both maintenance workers for a petroleum refinery were troubleshooting an automated valve in the "Prime G Unit". Flammable gasoline/hydrocarbons in the piping and flange portion of the automated valve were released causing an explosion and fire. Employee #1 sustained 3rd degree burns to over 83% of his body and was hospitalized. Employee #2 sustained 3rd degree burns to over 93% of his body and died on May 26, 2023.

events.title: Employee dies after fall from scissor lift
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Wachter, Inc. Oklahoma City, OK. At 3:00 a.m. on May 20, 2023, an employee was in a scissor lift, installing a cable for a Wi-Fi access point in a retail building. As the employee was pulling the cable through the ceiling rafters, the cable swung hitting the light fixture. The employee suddenly paused, went limp, and fell onto boxes located in the scissor lift that were at the same height as the mid rail. The employee appeared to come to and rolled over through the top rail and the mid rail of theguardrail system of the…

events.title: Employee is killed in trench collapse
events.description: 1 worker death. Mcalester, OK. At 11:00 a.m. on May 18, 2023, an employee was in an unprotected 10 foot trench,leveling gravel underneath a 24-inch PVC sewer line. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed by electrocution
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Libra Electric Company. Tulsa, OK. At 3:15 p.m. on May 15, 2023, an employee was servicing a taxiway light. The employee cleared the contacts of a tester and preceded to perform the isolation work. The employee did not perform a second test to determine if the 5kV wire was live. The employee started to remove the electrical tape at the end of the electrical connection to the taxiway light that was connected to a series circuit. As the employee began to disconnect the connectors, the employee contacted the live male end of the…

events.title: Employee is killed when stuck in chest by flying plug
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Accurate Manufacturing, Inc. Tulsa, OK. At 4:00 p.m. on April 14, 2023, an employee working for a structural sheet metalmanufacturer was performing hydrostatic testing on an air-conditioned heat exchanger. A plug failed under pressure striking the employee. The employee was killed after being impaled in the chest by the plug.

events.title: Employee is killed in trench collapse
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Dawson Does It Plumbing Inc. Holdenville, OK. At 3:45 p.m. on April 10, 2023, an employee was working inside an unprotected trench, performing sewer line tap and installation into the city sewer line and a residential home. The employee was working in a trench at a depth of 12 feet. The soil collapsed onto the employee, killing the employee.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by truck
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Sooner Towing And Recovery Service. Harrah, OK. At 9:30 p.m. on March 28, 2023, an employee working as a tow truck driver was securing a vehicle to his truck. The employee was struck by a passing semi tractor trailer truck. The employee sustained several blunt force trauma injuries including fractures, lacerations and dislocations and died.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by vehicle
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: American Waste Control, Inc. Sand Springs, OK. At 5:53 a.m. on November 14, 2022, an employee was driving on their route to service customers. The driver was stopped on the road, collecting waste. As the employee crossed the road to return a trash bin to a customer's property, he wasstruck by a vehicle in oncoming traffic. The employee suffered multiple fractures and internal injuries, killing him.

events.title: Employee Is Killed In Fall Through Roof
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: White Roofing Llc. Seminole, OK. At 11:45 a.m. on September 16, 2022, an employee was removing existing metal roofing material to prepare for installing new metal roofing. While the employee was picking up the removed screws, she fell 17 feet through the roofing insulation into the residential shop building. The employee fractured her head and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when stabbed in back
events.description: 1 worker death. Holdenville, OK. At 9:00 a.m. on July 31, 2022, an employee was bringing inmates from the recreation yard into the sally port of the housing unit. An inmate stabbed the employee in the back with a homemade shiv.

events.title: Employee dies of drug overdose
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Wedlake Enclosure Systems. Tulsa, OK. At 6:30 p.m. on July 6, 2022, an employee was found unresponsive by fellow employees. The employee reported to his regular shift at 3:00 p.m. The employer reported drug abuse by the employee was common. A preliminary report by the ME depicted the incident being an accident and the cause of death to be overdose.

events.title: Two employees are killed in oxygen deficient atmosphere
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Belt Construction, Inc. Edmond, OK. At 4:15 p.m. on June 14, 2022, two employees entered a 21-inch sewer manhole to conduct vacuum testing, not knowing that it was oxygen deficient. Both employee were overcome and died.

events.title: Employee is killed when saw kicks back and strikes neck
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Southern Demolition, Llc. Stillwater, OK. At 7:00 p.m. on May 21, 2022, an employee was cutting a door opening in a concrete wall when the concrete saw kicked back. The employee was struck in the neck by the saw blade and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: National Waste & Disposal, Inc. Broken Arrow, OK. At 10:00 a.m. on April 11, 2022, an employee was collecting trash with a front loader trash truck (truck #48 - 2021 Mack Truck). The employee was allegedly attempting to extinguish a fire in the trash truck, when he fell from an elevation (greater than 4 feet). The employee suffered multiple blunt injuries and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when shot in convenience store by robbers…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Maine-Street Mini Mart, Inc. Enid, OK. At 2:30 a.m. on February 18, 2022, an employee was working alone in a convenience store at night, when three people came in wearing masks with a rifle and a gun and told the employee to give them the cash. The employee was killed due to multiple rifle shots.

events.title: Employee dies of aneurism
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Atc Drivetrain, Llc. Oklahoma City, OK. At 5:30 a.m. on January 20, 2022, an employee was wire brushing old gaskets off of transmissions. The employee collapsed twenty minutes into his shift. The medical examiner reported that the employee died of an aneurysm.

events.title: Employee is killed when pinned by conveyor against wall
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Red River Mixing, Llc. Idabel, OK. At 7:40 a.m. on November 14, 2021, an employee was loading materials into a mixer when a small bag of chemicals fell from the conveyor belt onto the floor. The employee bent down to pick the bag up when the conveyor engaged and pinned him against a wall. The employee incurred crushing injuries to his chest and waskilled.

events.title: Employee falls, hits head, and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Herbert Malarkey Roofing Company. Oklahoma City, OK. At 5:15 p.m. on November 12, 2021, an employee was plastic wrapping a pallet, when he got dizzy and fell and hit his head. The employee was killed, and had a laceration over his left eye and a black eye. It was believed that the employee either fell and hit the pallet or hit the ground.

events.title: Employee is crushed and killed by falling pipes
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Doral Corporation. Oklahoma City, OK. At 8:45 a.m. on November 8, 2021, an employee worked from a scissor lift to remove suspended pipes. The employee cut the support to the pipes while reachingthrough the pipes to make the cut. The pipes fell on top of the employee, who was crushed, suffocated, and killed between the pipes and the scissor lift

events.title: Employee is killed when pulled into silo by conveyor system…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: T.J. Campbell Construction Co. Oklahoma City, OK. At 10:30 a.m. on November 2, 2021, an employee stood on a conveyor belt to cleandebris from the belt. At some point, the system cycled, and the employee was pulled into a silo containing hot (350-400 degree) asphalt. The employee was killed by the burn and crush injuries received.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by falling generator
events.description: 1 worker death. Edmond, OK. At 9:40 a.m. on October 6, 2021, an employee was assisting a coworker in unloading two stacked generators. A generator fell and struck the employee, pushing him off the end of trailer. The employee was killed.

events.title: Four employees with COVID-19 infections die
events.description: 4 worker deaths. Employer: Pliant, Llc. Mcalester, OK. Employee #1 worked on line 26 in the converting department and began having COVID-19 symptoms on August 29, 2021 and tested positive the same day. Contact tracing did not identify any other employee as a close contact. Employee #1 died on September 15, 2021. Employee #2 worked in the office and on line 15 in the extrusion department. Employee #2 began…

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Us Department Of Agriculture. Broken Bow, OK. An employee was working out of the local office of a federal regulatory agency. She worked as a consumer safety inspector (CSI) for a food safety inspection service. She inspected poultry at a poultry processing facility. While she was there, some workers for the firm that owned the facility were reported to be infected with or had tested positive for COVID-19. The employee might have been exposed to them. She contracted COVID-19. At 5:15 a.m. on September 20, 2021, she died.

events.title: Employee is killed due to explosion while welding
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Asphalt Express Enterprises, L.L.C. Ardmore, OK. At 10:00 a.m. on July 16, 2021, an employee was killed due to burns from a fire following an explosion that occurred while he was welding. The source of the explosion is unknown, but believed to be gases from the tank farm where he was working or welding gases ignited by either a vehicle or a welding machine.

events.title: Employee contacts energized powerline, is electrocuted, and…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Res System 3 Llc. Sulphur, OK. At 10:45 a.m. on July 7, 2021, an employee worked to transfer existing energizedpower transmission lines from an old utility pole to a new one. At some point, the employee made contact with an energized line, was electrocuted, and killed.

events.title: Employee dies from possible heat illness
events.description: 1 worker death. Enid, OK. At 7:15 p.m. on June 20, 2021, an employee was loading grain into elevators when he lost consciousness. The employee died from possible heat exposure.

events.title: Employee is killed while cleaning headhouse
events.description: 1 worker death. Enid, OK. At 07:15 p.m. on June 20, 2021, an employee was cleaning grain in a headhouse. The employee lost of consciousness, possibly due to a heat related illness and died as a result.

events.title: Employee is killed in lift after contacting power lines
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: L & R Tree Service. Oklahoma City, OK. At 6:45 p.m. on April 22, 2021, an employee was operating an aerial bucket lift trimming a tree when the employee contacted energized power lines. The employee was electrocuted and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall through opening in platform
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Wilson Construction And Concrete, Inc. Tulsa, OK. At approximately 7:00 a.m. on April 16, 2021, Employee #1 was assisting in removing rebar from the end of a concrete surface when he fell through an opening in the walking platform. The employee fell 60 feet to the concrete surface below, and died.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by garbage truck
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: American Waste Control, Inc. Tulsa, OK. At 6:45 a.m. on March 19, 2021, Employee #1 exited the garbage truck he was driving and walked in front of it. The vehicle was not set in park and rolled forward striking and killing him.

events.title: Employee is killed after entering tank trailer and becoming…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Hs Field Services, Inc. Okmulgee, OK. At 8:30 p.m. on February 16, 2021, an employee entered a tank trailer containing a condensate/salt water mixture in order to unfreeze internal lines. The employee was asphyxiated and killed.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Southern Oaks Care Center. Pawnee, OK. At 5:19 on January 18 , 2021, an employee working as a nurse became ill with COVID-19. She later was hospitalized and died.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Life Care Oklahoma Hospice, Inc. Norman, OK. At 3:00 p.m. on January 14, 2021, an employee who worked as a Licensed PracticalNurse for a home health hospice company died from complications due to COVID-19.During one of her patient visits the employee began experiencing symptoms. She was admitted to the hospital, where she tested positive for COVID-19. Information regarding engineering, administrative and personal protective equipment controls for COVID-19 are not included in the narrative.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: N & R Of Ponca City, Llc. Ponca City, OK. At approximately 3:15 a.m. on January 7, 2021, a screening employee at the facility died of COVID-19 complications.

events.title: Employee dies at pipeline excavation site
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: North Central Service, Inc. Talihina, OK. At 2:15 p.m. on January 4, 2020, Employee #1, employed by a construction company, was found unresponsive with his head and shoulders hanging partially into a 4-foot excavated hole. He had been digging by hand to locate a pipe before the planned use of an excavator to dig a larger hole. Cause of death wasunknown at time of report, but Employee #1 may have died of natural causes.

events.title: Employee is killed while using propane torch to unfreeze wat…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Orr Enterprises Inc. Kingfisher, OK. At 8:15 a.m. on December 17, 2020, an employee used an open flame propane torch to unthaw a frozen valve on the vacuum transfer pump of a 70 barrel vacuum truck. The transfer pump contained flammable liquids. The employee was conducting well plugging operations at the time of the incident. The explosion caused the rear hatch of the vacuum truck to fly off, striking the employee in the face and chest area which killed him.

events.title: Employee is killed after caught between trailer frame and ti…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Dollar Trucking, Llc. Hennessey, OK. At approximately 6:00 p.m. on December 9, 2020, an employee was closing an air tank petcock valve located between the dual wheels of a trailer. The trailer frame lowered when the employee's head was caught between the trailer frame and a trailer tire. The employee was killed after suffering head fractures and suffocation.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from crane
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Cmc Steel Oklahoma, Llc. Durant, OK. At 11:45 a.m. on November 29, 2020, an employee, a crane operator, was being relieved from crane operations by a coworker for a break. After the coworker had relieved the employee, he was attempting to descend from the cab when he fell approximately 40 feet to the ground. The employee died of multiple injuriesupon contact with the ground.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Ssm Healthcare Of Oklahoma, Inc. Oklahoma City, OK. At approximately 5:00 a.m. on November 24, 2020, an employee was working with a contingent worker who had tested positive for COVID-19. The employee began to experience on-set symptoms and was directed to quarantine COVID-19 related illness COVID-19. The employee later died from complications from COVID-19.

events.title: Employee is killed when tire over-inflates and explodes
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Atlas Paving Company. Oklahoma City, OK. At 2:00 p.m. on November 17, 2020, Employee #1, employed by a road paving company, was adding air to the right rear tire of a front end loader. The air gauge or other tool used to measure air pressure failed to indicate when the optimum tire pressure had been achieved. The tire over-inflated and exploded, striking the employee. Employee #1 sustained blunt force traumatic injuries to multiple internal organs and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from pipe
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Ocv Fluid Solutions Llc. Tulsa, OK. At 5:45 a.m. on November 16, 2020, Employee #1 was standing on top of 10-inch water pipe looking for a part. The employee fell from the top of the pipe, struck the nearby wall and ground, and landed on a work part. He was impaled in the skull and killed by the skull puncture and broken neck.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall off moving forklift
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: J & I Manufacturing Inc. Madill, OK. At 11:15 a.m. on November 16, 2020, an employee was standing on the step of a moving forklift that was being driven by a coworker. The employee reached for the mast of the forklift and lost his balance, falling to ground beneath the forklift. The forklift rolled over the employee crushing his chest and skull. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee with COVID-19 infection dies
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Life Care Oklahoma Hospice, Inc. Chickasha, OK. An employee was working as a nurse in a skilled nursing facility and was eating lunch with a coworker, another nurse, without practicing social distancing. The employee began having symptoms of COVID-19 and subsequently died from her infection at 5:00 p.m. on October 28, 2020. The coworker tested positive for COVID-19 but did not require hospitalization for treatment.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by steel cable
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Envirodispose Llc. Midwest City, OK. At 11:15 a.m. on October 5, 2020, an employee was loading a roll-off box onto a flatbed truck. The employee was tensioning a steel cable when the cable retainerpin broke causing the cable to fly back toward the cab of the truck and striking the employee in the back of the head. events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Northern Ag Service, Inc. Enid, OK. At 9:00 a.m. on August 22, 2015, Employee #1 was riding the manlift to the top floor of a grain elevator. The manlift failed to stop on the top floor and the employee was unable to get off. Employee #1 was carried to the ceiling, where he was wedged between the ceiling and head pulley. He was crushed and killed.

events.title: Employee Is Crushed In Between Dumpster And Concrete Post An…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Maverick Transportation, Llc. Tulsa, OK. At approximately 2:30 p.m. on July 17, 2015, Employee #1, a spotter, was assisting a driver with the positioning of a truck's flatbed for offloading. Thetruck backed up and snagged a dumpster on the corner of its flatbed. Employee #1was in front of the driver and moved for an unknown reason and went to stand next to the dumpster. The truck driver moved forward causing the dumpster to jackknife and strike Employee #1. He was killed when crushed between the dumpster and a concrete post.

events.title: Employee Is Killed In Fall During Chicken House Construction…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Tavares Construction. Colcord, OK. At 9:30 a.m. on July 9, 2015, an employee was setting roof trusses while framing a chicken house. The employee was killed when they fell approximately 11 feet to the concrete.

events.title: Employee falls off a forklift and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Hodges Trucking Co. Llc. Oklahoma City, OK. At 4:00 p.m. on June 27, 2015, an employee was raised in the air while standing on the tines of the forklift in an attempt to close the overhead door. The overhead door became unstuck and closed, knocking the employee from the tines of the forklift, causing the employee to fall to the concrete ground below. The employee sustained a fractured neck and was killed.

events.title: Employee Is Struck By Forklift And Treated For Internal Blee…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Advance Pierre Foods Inc. Enid, OK. At 7:00 p.m. on June 18, 2015, an employee was passing by a forklift that was coming down an aisle when the forklift struck him. The employee died from internal bleeding.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by an object
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: H & H Masonry Contractors, Inc. Oklahoma City, OK. At approximately 2:00 p.m. on June 5, 2015, Employee #1 was installing and hooking up new hydraulic lines and fittings on a portable grout-mud mixer. The drum of the grout-mud mixer was raised and Employee #1 was sitting under the drum. A hydraulic fitting either came loose or was removed and the drum came down trapping and crushing him. He was bent at the waist with the drum sitting on his back and died.

events.title: Employee falls from scaffold and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Jimco Masonry Llc. Muskogee, OK. At approximately 2:50 p.m. on June 3, 2015, Employee #1 was climbing down a scaffold when he fell and died.

events.title: Employee is killed when caught in a blow mold machine
events.description: 1 worker death. Miami, OK. At approximately 5:15 a.m. on May 13, 2015, Employee #1 was attending to a jam on a blow molding machine. He freed the material causing the jam and restarted the machine. Employee #1 was caught between the mold clamping arm and the I-beamframe of the guard and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed by crane
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Quad/Graphics, Inc. Oklahoma City, OK. At 5:00 a.m. on April 24, 2015 an employee was observing a lifting fixture of a crane being operated in a cylinder printing plant storage area. The crane lifting fixture descended onto the employee pushing the employee to the ground. The employee was found with his legs stretched out and his torso pushed down on his legs. His bent over body was compressed into a vertical space of about 10 inches. The employee was killed due to blunt force trauma to the torso and possible asphyxia.

events.title: Employee Drowns While Working On a Saltwater Receiving Tank…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Overflow Energy, Llc. Cheyenne, OK. At 3:00 p.m. on February 20, 2015, an employee was grinding on a "U" shaped pipe at top of a saltwater receiving tank. An explosion and fire occurred at the tank which blew off the tank lid. The employee fell 16 feet into the tank whichheld saltwater from the oil and gas drilling operations and drowned.

events.title: Employee is electrocuted while repairing power line
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Alfa Laval Inc. Broken Arrow, OK. At 9:15 a.m. on February 13, 2015, Employee #1 was working on the neutral lines and lowered the bucket to retrieve a tap rod. Employee #1 was part of a electrical pole replacement crew. As Employee #1 attempted to remove energized power lines from a existing pole and transfer the line to a new pole, Employee #1, "without protective gloves" reached up and made contact with the live power-line and was electrocuted. Employee #1 was killed as a result from being electrocuted with 7200 volts.

events.title: Employee is electrocuted and killed by contact with overhead…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Texoma Powerline, Inc. Muldrow, OK. At 9:15 a.m. on February 13, 2015, an employee was working on neutral lines in abucket truck. The employee lowered the bucket to retrieve a tap rod, elevated the bucket above the neutral lines to the live power lines carrying 7,200v. The employee reached to grab the armor guard on the live lines and was electrocuted.At the time of the accident, he was not wearing the proper protective gloves when he made contact with the overhead power lines.
